crusadecraft.city.title: Cities of the realm
crusadecraft.city.open.tip: The colonies of your realm: held directly or entrusted to a governor, and what they owe the crown.
crusadecraft.city.attach: Attach the colony I am in
crusadecraft.city.attach.tip: Make this colony, which is yours, a city of your realm.
crusadecraft.city.attach.none.tip: Stand in another MineColonies colony that you own, then reopen this screen. (Owning several colonies needs MineColonies' allowinfinitecolonies setting.)
crusadecraft.city.attach.none: You are not standing in a colony of yours that can be attached.
crusadecraft.city.attach.already: %s is already a city of your realm.
crusadecraft.city.domain: Domain: %s city(ies) held directly out of %s without penalty (beyond: −%s %% taxes per city)
crusadecraft.city.tax.tip: Share of the city's taxes that goes to the crown; the governor keeps the rest. Click: +10 · Shift + click: −10.
crusadecraft.city.levy.tip: Share of the city's men who join the crown's army. Click: +10 · Shift + click: −10.
crusadecraft.city.share.direct: A city held directly pays everything to the crown.
crusadecraft.city.governor.tip: Click: entrust the city to the next person in the lineage register (Shift: the previous one). “Held directly” takes it back.
crusadecraft.city.governor.none.tip: Nobody can govern: add members to your house or attach people to your realm in the lineage register.
crusadecraft.city.governor.none: Nobody in the lineage register can govern for you.
crusadecraft.city.governor.invalid: This person cannot govern for you (alive, and of your house or your realm).
crusadecraft.city.capital: The capital stays held directly by the ruler.
crusadecraft.city.not_yours: This colony is not a city of your realm.
crusadecraft.city.direct.already: This city is already held directly.
crusadecraft.city.entrusted: %s is entrusted to %s: %s %% of taxes and %s %% of levies for the crown.
crusadecraft.city.recalled: %s returns to the crown's direct rule.
crusadecraft.city.over: Beyond your domain limit: this city yields %s %% less tax. Entrust it to a governor, or rise in rank.
crusadecraft.city.hint: Entrust the cities beyond your domain to a governor from the register.
crusadecraft.treasury.colony.governor: Governed by %s: %s %% of taxes for the crown
crusadecraft.codex.villes.p0: Another MineColonies colony of yours becomes a $(l)city$() of the realm: royal menu, $(l)Cities$() button, then $(l)Attach$() while standing in it (or a Boundary stone). Each city pays its taxes and provides its levies.
crusadecraft.codex.villes.p1: A ruler holds only so many cities directly, by rank; beyond that, each yields less. Entrust some to a $(l)governor$() from the lineage register: they keep their share of taxes and levies, you set yours. You stay the MineColonies owner.
